details.description: A daily shampoo made with aloe and oat, for 72-hour hydration.
details.ingredients: Aqua (Water), Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Glycerin, Sodium Chloride, Coco-Glucoside, Glyceryl Oleate, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract, Sodium PCA, Panthenol, Citric Acid, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Parfum (Fragrance).
details.warnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse well with water.

details.description: A two-minute conditioner made with aloe, oat and rice protein. It detangles without weigh-down.
benefits: Made with aloe, oat and rice protein
details.ingredients: Aqua (Water), Cetearyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Behentrimonium Chloride, Cetyl Esters, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract, Panthenol, Hydrolyzed Rice Protein, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Parfum (Fragrance).
details.directions: Apply to clean, wet hair, leave 2 min, rinse.
details.warnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse well with water.

details.description: A rinse-out hair mask made with shea butter, keratin and argan oil. Leave it on damp hair for 5 to 10 minutes to repair 3 months of damage.
benefits: Made with shea butter, keratin and argan oil
details.ingredients: Aqua (Water), Cetearyl Alcohol, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Glycerin, Behentrimonium Chloride, Hydrolyzed Keratin, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract, Panthenol, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Parfum (Fragrance).
details.directions: Apply to damp hair, leave 5–10 min, rinse.
details.warnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse well with water.

details.description: A clinically tested, fragrance-free leave-in scalp serum made with niacinamide, caffeine and oat. A few drops massage straight into the scalp, with no rinsing.
benefits: Made with niacinamide, caffeine and oat
details.ingredients: Aqua (Water), Propanediol, Glycerin, Niacinamide, Caffeine, Panthenol, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Sodium PCA, Xanthan Gum, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate.
details.directions: Apply 4–6 drops to scalp, massage. Do not rinse.
details.warnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse well with water. Stop use if irritation occurs.

details.description: Three VERDA hair care essentials in TSA-ready 90 mL bottles: Shampoo, Conditioner and Hair Mask.
benefits: Includes Shampoo, Conditioner and Hair Mask
details.ingredients:
Shampoo: Aqua (Water), Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Glycerin, Sodium Chloride, Coco-Glucoside, Glyceryl Oleate, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract, Sodium PCA, Panthenol, Citric Acid, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Parfum (Fragrance).
Conditioner: Aqua (Water), Cetearyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Behentrimonium Chloride, Cetyl Esters, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract, Panthenol, Hydrolyzed Rice Protein, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Parfum (Fragrance).
Hair Mask: Aqua (Water), Cetearyl Alcohol, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Glycerin, Behentrimonium Chloride, Hydrolyzed Keratin, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract, Panthenol, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Parfum (Fragrance).
details.directions: Shampoo: Massage into wet hair, rinse. Conditioner: Apply to wet hair, leave 2 min, rinse. Hair Mask: Leave 5–10 min, rinse.
details.warnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse well with water.
